x-m-e2-10.title: Nhamba inotevera 1, 2, 4 i imwe chete here?
x-m-e2-10.goal: Dzidza kuti nhamba dzekutanga mbishi hadzisarudze pattern kuita imwe chete, uye kuti unofanira kugadzirisa pattern kana nhamba itsva yaratidzwa, uye gadzira nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern iwe pachako.
x-m-e2-10.material: Shamwari mukirasi yedu ari kutamba mutambo wenhamba sequence apo anoratidza nhamba rimwe nerimwe. Shamwari yasarudza pattern imwe chete uye inokuudza nhamba imwe imwe panguva.
x-m-e2-10.thinking.0: Kufunga nezve mukana wema patterns akawanda
x-m-e2-10.thinking.2: Kuita nhamba sequence inoenderana ne pattern
x-m-e2-10.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekutarisa musiyano pakati penhamba dziri padyo mu nhamba sequence (Grade 2 level)
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.prompt: Funga pattern nguva imwe neimwe nhamba yaratidzwa.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora misiyano pakati penhamba dziri padyo.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana pattern yako inoenderana nenhamba itsva yaratidzwa.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Nhamba dzekutanga nhatu dze number pattern i 1, 2, 4. Mutemo wakasarudzwa neshamwari yako i wekuti nhamba dzinoramba dzichikura kupfuura nhamba yapfuura. Funga nhamba inotevera nemutemo.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Sarudza nhamba dzose dzinogona kuuya inotevera pasi pemutemo wakadaro.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Kunyange nemutemo wekuti nhamba dzinoramba dzichikura, nhamba dzekutanga nhatu oga hadzisarudze mutemo kuita mumwe chete. 7, 8, ne 5 zvose zvinogona kubva pamutemo wakati.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakafunga pattern apo nhamba inowedzerwa inokura se 1, 2, 3. Kana wakaisiya, nyora misiyano pakati penhamba dziri padyo.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafunga pattern apo nhamba imwe neimwe i ka2 yenhamba yapfuura.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakafunga pattern apo unowedzera 1 ne 2 nenhevedzano. Kana wakaisiya, inyore se 1, 2, 4, 5, 7.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Mutemo weshamwari yako i wekuti nhamba dzinoramba dzichikura. Tarisa kana 3 i yakakura kupfuura nhamba iri pamberi payo, 4.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Nhamba imwe zvakare ye sequence yaratidzwa. I 1, 2, 4, 7.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ndeipi pattern inoenderana nenhamba dzose ina?
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Misiyano i 1, 2, 3, saka pattern yekuti nhamba inowedzerwa inokura ne 1 chete ndiyo yasara. Kana pane ruzivo rutsva, unofanira kurasa ma patterns asingaenderane.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Mushure me 1, 2, 4 i 7, kwete 8, saka pattern iyi yaputsika.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Pattern iyi inopa 1, 2, 4, 5, saka haienderane nenhamba ino 7. Nyora misiyano pakati penhamba dziri padyo.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waona kuti misiyano pakati penhamba dziri padyo inokura se 1, 2, 3.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Nhamba inowedzerwa inokura se 1, 2, 3, 4, saka inotevera unowedzera 5 uye unowana 16.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakafunga kuti musiyano i 4 imwechete. Tarisa kana misiyano iri 1, 2, 3, 4.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakapetwa nhamba yapfuura. Tarisa kana inoenderana neruzivo rwapfuura.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakaenderera mberi nepattern apo nhamba inowedzerwa inoenda ku 5 mushure me 4.
x-m-e2-10.s.s1.reflect: Nenhamba dzekutanga nhatu, ma patterns akawanda aigoneka, asi nhamba dzichiwedzera, ma patterns asina kuenderana akanyangarika. Pattern inofanira kuenderana nenhamba dzose dzaunoziva, uye kana isingaenderane, unofanira kuigadzirisa.
x-m-e2-10.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira nhamba 4 nepattern apo nhamba inowedzerwa inokura ne 1. Ndedzi nhamba yekutanga a, nhamba yechipiri b, nhamba yechitatu c, uye nhamba yechina d. Wana nhamba sequences 3 dzakasiyana. (Nhamba i 40 kana pasi.)

x-m-e2-10.s.s2.hint.1: Ipapo sarudza c ne d, uchitarisa kuti nhamba inowedzerwa inokura ne 1.
x-m-e2-10.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba i nhamba dzakazara kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 40.
x-m-e2-10.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 40.
x-m-e2-10.s.s2.ok.c2: Nhamba inova yakakura ichibva pane yekutanga ichienda kune yechipiri.
x-m-e2-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Nhamba yechipiri inofanira kuva yakakura kupfuura yekutanga.
x-m-e2-10.s.s2.ok.c3: Nhamba inowedzerwa kubva kune yechipiri kuenda kune yechitatu i 1 yakawanda.
x-m-e2-10.s.s2.fail.c3: Tarisa kana nhamba inowedzerwa kubva ku b kuenda ku c i 1 yakawanda kupfuura nhamba inowedzerwa kubva ku a kuenda ku b.
x-m-e2-10.s.s2.ok.c4: Nhamba inowedzerwa kubva kune yechitatu kuenda kune yechina i 1 yakawanda.
x-m-e2-10.s.s2.fail.c4: Tarisa kana nhamba inowedzerwa kubva ku c kuenda ku d i 1 yakawanda kupfuura nhamba inowedzerwa kubva ku b kuenda ku c.
x-m-e2-10.s.s2.explain: Kuti nhamba yaunowedzera ikure ne1, misiyano inofanira kuenderera se1, 2, 3 kana 2, 3, 4. 1, 2, 4, 7 ine misiyano 1, 2, 3, uye 2, 4, 7, 11 ine misiyano 2, 3, 4.

x-m-e2-01.title: Tsvaga nhamba yakavanzika yaSuji
x-m-e2-01.goal: Shandisa nzvimbo dzenhamba kuwana nhamba yenhamba nhatu inosangana nemakwara akawanda panguva imwe chete, uye usarudze makwara nekuenzanisa kuti nhamba dzingani dzinosara pakwara rimwe nerimwe.
x-m-e2-01.material:
Suji akasarudza nhamba yenhamba nhatu ndokupa makwara.
Kwara 1) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi ndi 2 kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe.
Kwara 2) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yeimwe haisi 0.
Kwara 3) Nhamba iri munzvimbo yemazana yakakura kupfuura nhamba iri munzvimbo yegumi.
x-m-e2-01.thinking.0: Kugadzira muenzaniso unosangana nemakwara akawanda panguva imwe chete
x-m-e2-01.thinking.2: Kuenzanisa makwara kusarudza rinosimbisa mhinduro kuva imwe chete
x-m-e2-01.prereq.0: Nzvimbo dzemazana, gumi, neimwe dzenhamba yenhamba nhatu nezvinoreva nhamba imwe neimwe (padanho reGiredhi 2)
x-m-e2-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nhamba dzese pakati pedzina dzinogona kuva nhamba yaSuji. (Inofanira kusangana nemakwara ese matatu.)
x-m-e2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba imwe uye uiedze nemakwara 1, 2, ne 3 nenzira.
x-m-e2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti kwara rega rega riri pamusoro penzvimbo ipi nekutaura mazita enzvimbo.
x-m-e2-01.s.s1.r.a: Kana wakasarudza 420: unogona kunge wakatarisa hukama hwenzvimbo yegumi neyeimwe chete uye usina kutarisa kuti nhamba yeimwe ndeyei. Edza kwara rega rega rimwe nerimwe.
x-m-e2-01.s.s1.r.b: Kana wakasarudza 642: wakatarisa makwara matatu nzvimbo nenzvimbo, rimwe panguva. Kana wakashaya, tarisa kwara rega rega zvakare pamwe chete nemazita enzvimbo.
x-m-e2-01.s.s1.r.c: Kana wakasarudza 353: wakaona hukama hwegumi neimwe zvakarurama, asi unogona kunge usina kutarisa kwara rinoenzanisa nzvimbo yemazana neyegumi.
x-m-e2-01.s.s1.r.d: Kana wakasarudza 975: wakatarisa makwara nzvimbo nenzvimbo. Kana wakashaya, edza makwara matatu nenhamba iyi rimwe nerimwe.
x-m-e2-01.s.s1.explain: 420 ine 0 munzvimbo yeimwe, saka inopikisa kwara 2, uye 353 ine 3 munzvimbo yemazana, iri pasi pe 5 munzvimbo yegumi, saka inopikisa kwara 3. 642 ne 975 dzinosangana nemakwara ese matatu.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira nhamba dzakasiyana dzenhamba nhatu dzinosangana nemakwara ese aSuji. (Nhamba yemazana a, nhamba yegumi b, nhamba yeimwe c)
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kana ukasarudza nhamba yeimwe kutanga, nhamba yegumi inosarudzwa. Ipapo funga nezvenzvimbo yemazana.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.hint.1: Edza nhamba dzawakagadzira nemakwara 1, 2, ne 3 rimwe nerimwe.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba yemazana iri pakati pe 1 ne 9.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba yemazana inofanira kuva nhamba imwe kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 9.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Nzvimbo dzegumi neimwe ndi nhamba dzimwe chete.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Nhamba dzegumi neimwe dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzimwe chete kubva pa 0 kusvika pa 9.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Nhamba yegumi ndi 2 kupfuura nhamba yeimwe.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Tarisa zvakare kana nhamba yegumi iri 2 kupfuura nhamba yeimwe.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.ok.c5: Nhamba yemazana yakakura kupfuura nhamba yegumi.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.fail.c5: Tarisa kana nhamba yemazana yakakura kupfuura nhamba yegumi.
x-m-e2-01.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, pane 431, 642, ne 975. Kana ukasarudza nhamba yeimwe kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 7, nhamba yegumi inosarudzwa, uye kunzvimbo yemazana unogona kusarudza nhamba ipi neipi yakakura kupfuura iyoyo. Pane nhamba dzakawanda dzinogoneka, saka unoda makwara akawanda.
x-m-e2-01.s.s3.prompt: Suji anopa kwara rimwe zvakare. Nderipi, kana wariteerera, rinosimbisa nhamba yakavanzika kuva imwe chete?
x-m-e2-01.s.s3.hint.0: Wedzera kwara rimwe uye unyore nhamba dzese dzinogoneka.
x-m-e2-01.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti nhamba dzingani dzinosara pakwara rega rega.
x-m-e2-01.s.s3.r.a: Kwara iri roga rinosiya zvinogoneka zvakawanda zvenhamba yegumi, kubva pa 3 kusvika pa 8. Zvakakosha kuverenga iwe pachako kuti kwara rinoderedza kusvika pa nhamba dzingani.
x-m-e2-01.s.s3.r.b: Zvakanaka kana wakawana nyaya dzese apo huwandu ndi 12, asi kana wakawana imwe chete ukamira, unofanira kutarisa zvakawanda kuona kana nyaya dzimwe dzasara.
x-m-e2-01.s.s3.r.c: Wakafunga kuti kana nzvimbo yeimwe yasarudzwa, unogona kuenderera uchishandisa makwara mamwe kuwana nzvimbo dzegumi nemazana.
x-m-e2-01.s.s3.r.d: Kana nzvimbo yegumi yasarudzwa, nzvimbo yeimwe inosarudzwa, asi zvinogoneka zvakawanda zvinogona kusara kunzvimbo yemazana.
x-m-e2-01.s.s3.explain: Kana nhamba yeimwe ndi 6, nhamba yegumi ndi 8, uye nhamba yemazana inogona kungova 9, iri yakakura kupfuura 8, saka 986 chete ndiyo inosara. Kana nhamba yemazana ndi 9, pane zvinogoneka 6; kana nhamba yegumi ndi 5, pane 4 (631, 731, 831, 931); uye kana huwandu ndi 12, mbiri dzinosara, 642 ne 831.

x-m-e2-02.goal: Tarisa nemuenzaniso unopikisa, uye utsanangure, kuti saizi yenhamba haisarudzwi nehuwandu hwenhamba dzayo asi nekuenzanisa kubva panzvimbo yepamusoro.
x-m-e2-02.material: Hayun aida kuziva kuti ndeipi pamaviri enhamba dzenhamba nhatu iri huru, uye akanyora mhinduro nenzira yake.

x-m-e2-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wemhinduro yaHayun apo kufunga kwakanganisa kunotanga kuoneka. (Verenga mitsetse uchitanga pamutsetse 1.)

x-m-e2-02.s.s1.line.0: Ngatiwane kuti ndeipi iri huru, 399 kana 401.

x-m-e2-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso apo nzira yaHayun yakanganisa. Tsvaga nhamba x ine nhamba dzinowedzera kusvika pakukura asi chaizvo idiki, nenhamba y ine nhamba dzinowedzera kusvika pakudiki asi iri huru. Gadzira maviri maviri.
x-m-e2-02.s.s2.hint.0: Funga nhamba apo nhamba yemazana iri diki asi nhamba dzegumi neimwe dzakakura.

x-m-e2-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Verenga zvakare kana huwandu hwenhamba dzese dze x hwakakura kupfuura huwandu hwenhamba dzese dze y.
x-m-e2-02.s.s2.explain: Kune 399 ne 401, huwandu hwenhamba ndi 21 ne 5, asi nhamba 399 ndiyo diki. Kune 199 ne 310, huwandu ndi 19 ne 4, asi 199 idiki. Kunyange muenzaniso mumwe chete apo nzira yakanganisa unoreva kuti "nguva dzose" hazvishande.
x-m-e2-02.s.s3.prompt: Ipapo, kana uchienzanisa saizi yenhamba mbiri dzenhamba nhatu, unofanira kutarisa nzvimbo ipi kutanga? Nyorawo chikonzero chako.

x-m-e2-03.title: 10 yakakwereterwa yakaenda kupi?
x-m-e2-03.goal: Tsvaga kanganiso mumhinduro yakashaya kuti nhamba inoshanduka munzvimbo yakakwereterwa, uye utsanangure kuti sei tichitarisa nekuwedzera uye mhinduro yakarurama ndeipi.

x-m-e2-03.s.s1.line.1: Nzvimbo yeimwe: Haugoni kutora 8 kubva pa 2, saka kwereta 10 kubva panzvimbo yegumi uye unyore 12−8=4.
x-m-e2-03.s.s1.line.2: Nzvimbo yegumi: Haugoni kutora 5 kubva pa 4, saka kwereta 10 kubva panzvimbo yemazana uye unyore 14−5=9.

x-m-e2-03.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga yakanganisa. Mumutsetse 2, 4 munzvimbo yegumi yakakwereta 10 kunzvimbo yeimwe, saka nzvimbo yegumi inova 3. Mumutsetse 3, haugoni kutora 5 kubva pa 3, saka unofanira kukwereta kubva panzvimbo yemazana uye unyore 13−5=8.
x-m-e2-03.s.s2.prompt: Seojin anoda kutarisa kana mhinduro 194 yakarurama. Nzira ipi inokuudza zvinotendeseka kuti yakanganisa?
x-m-e2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Funga nezvekuverenga kunobatana nekubvisa uye kunoridzosa shure.
x-m-e2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Funga rimwe nerimwe kana nzira imwe neimwe inotarisa nenzira yakasiyana kubva pamhinduro yekutanga.
x-m-e2-03.s.s2.o.a: Verenga zvakare nenzira imwe chete uone kana kukosha kwakafanana kwabuda
x-m-e2-03.s.s2.r.a: Kana ukaverenga zvakare nepfungwa imwe chete, unogona kudzokorora kanganiso imwe chete. Unofanira kutarisa nenzira yakasiyana.
x-m-e2-03.s.s2.r.b: Kutarisa uku kunoshandisa hukama hwekuti mhinduro yekubvisa pamwe chete nenhamba yakabviswa inopa nhamba yekutanga. Funga zvakare kuti sei hukama uhu hunoshanda.
x-m-e2-03.s.s2.r.c: Kubvisa 158 kubva pamhinduro kunoita kubvisa kutsva, saka zvakaoma kuenzanisa zvakananga nechirevo chepakutanga. Funga kana kunobatana nechirevo chaunoda kutarisa.
x-m-e2-03.s.s2.o.d: Tarisa kuti nhamba yeimwe 4 yakarurama chete
x-m-e2-03.s.s2.r.d: Kunyangwe ones place ichiri yakarurama, dzimwe nzvimbo dzinogona kuva dzisina kururama. Kutarisa nzvimbo imwe chete hakutarise zvose.
x-m-e2-03.s.s2.explain: 194+158=352, kwete 342. Mhinduro yekubvisa kuwedzera nhamba yaunobvisa inofanira kuva nhamba yekutanga, saka kuwana 352 kunoreva kuti 194 haina kururama.
x-m-e2-03.s.s3.prompt: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeyei? Nyorawo kuti Seojin akanganisa papi uye nei.

x-m-e2-07.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga waigona kutonga nekutarisa gumo rimwe chete, asi mushure mekuziva mark yegumo rimwe, wakawana kureba nenzira yakasiyana. Kana uchiyera kureba, unoda tsika yekutarisa kuti magumo maviri ari kupi.
x-m-e2-07.s.s2.prompt: Gumo rimwe repenzura riri pa mark a uye rimwe riri pa mark b. Tsvaga mamiriro matatu akasiyana apo penzura i 6cm kureba uye gumo rekuruboshwe risiri pa mark 0. (Ma marks epa ruler i kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 15.)
x-m-e2-07.s.s2.hint.0: Mark yegumo rekurudyi bvisa mark yegumo rekuruboshwe inofanira kuva 6.
x-m-e2-07.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza mark yegumo rekuruboshwe pakutanga, wobva watarisa kana gumo rekurudyi riri mukati me ruler.

x-m-e2-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Mark yegumo rekuruboshwe inofanira kuva 1 kana kupfuura uye mark yegumo rekurudyi inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara ye 15 kana pasi.
x-m-e2-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Pane mikaha 6 (6cm) pakati pema marks maviri.
x-m-e2-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Tarisa kana pane mikaha 6 pakati pema marks maviri. Edza kubvisa gumo rekuruboshwe kubva rekurudyi.
x-m-e2-07.s.s2.explain: Kana gumo rekuruboshwe i 1, rekurudyi i 7; kana rekuruboshwe i 2, i 8; kana rekuruboshwe i 9, i 15. Mark ipi neipi yegumo rekuruboshwe kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 9 inopa penzura i 6cm kureba.

x-m-e2-08.title: Firimu rinopera nguva ipi?
x-m-e2-08.goal: Tsvaga kukanganisa mugadziriso inowana nguva yekupera uchishandisa mutemo wekuti maminetsi 60 i awa 1, uye gadzira nguva yekuratidza inoenderana nemamiriro iwe pachako.
x-m-e2-08.material: Firimu rinotanga pa 1:40 pa movie theater. Nguva yekuratidza i maawa 2 maminetsi 30. Verenga gadziriso ya Ido.
x-m-e2-08.thinking.0: Kuwana mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso
x-m-e2-08.thinking.2: Kuita nguva dzakati wandei dzekuratidza dzinoenderana nemamiriro
x-m-e2-08.prereq.0: Maitiro ekuverenga clock, kuziva kuti maminetsi mangani ari muawa 1, kuverenga nguva dzine maawa nemaminetsi (Grade 2 level)
x-m-e2-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse apo gadziriso ya Ido inotanga kukanganisa. (Verenga mitsetse kutanga ne mutsetse 1.)
x-m-e2-08.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga nguva iri pamutsetse mumwe nemumwe nenzwi.
x-m-e2-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa imwe neimwe kana nguva yakanyorwa pamutsetse mumwe nemumwe i nguva yaunogona kuona chaizvo pa clock.
x-m-e2-08.s.s1.line.0: Firimu rinotanga pa 1:40 uye rinotora maawa 2 maminetsi 30. Wana nguva yekupera.
x-m-e2-08.s.s1.explain: Rinotanga kukanganisa pamutsetse 3. Maminetsi 20 mushure me 3:40 i 4:00, uye maminetsi 10 akawanda anoita 4:10. Kana maminetsi asvika 60 anofanira kunyorwa zvakare seawa 1, saka hapana nguva sa "maminetsi 70." Mutsetse 4 i mhedziso inotevedzera nguva isina kururama kubva pamutsetse 3.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.prompt: Firimu rinotanga pa 1:40. Sarudza nguva yekuratidza kuti nguva yekupera i 4:00 chaizvo kana mushure meizvozvo asi pamberi pe 5:00. Tsvaga mienzaniso 3 yakasiyana apo nguva yekuratidza i maawa h maminetsi m. (m i kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 59.)
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wawana kuti kubva pa 1:40 kusvika pa 4:00 i maawa mangani nemaminetsi mangani uye kuti kusvika pa 5:00 i yakawanda sei.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza maawa enguva yekuratidza, h, pakutanga, uye utarise kana maminetsi, m, anowira mukati merenji yakarurama.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Maawa i nhamba yakazara kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 5.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Maawa anofanira kuva nhamba yakazara kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 5.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Maminetsi anofanira kuva kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 59. Nyora maminetsi 60 seawa 1.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Nguva yekupera i 4:00 chaizvo kana mushure meizvozvo.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Nguva yekupera i pamberi pe 4:00. Nguva yekuratidza inofanira kuva refu.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.fail.c4: Nguva yekupera i 5:00 chaizvo kana mushure meizvozvo. Nguva yekuratidza inofanira kuva pfupi.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.explain: Kubva pa 1:40 kusvika pa 4:00 i maawa 2 maminetsi 20, uye kusvika pa 5:00 i maawa 3 maminetsi 20. Saka nguva yekuratidza inogona kuva chero kubva pamaawa 2 maminetsi 20 kusvika pasi pemaawa 3 maminetsi 20. Semuenzaniso, maawa 2 maminetsi 30, maawa 2 maminetsi 50, nemaawa 3 maminetsi 10.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangura nei usingafaniri kunyora maminetsi se 60 kana kupfuura, sa "maawa 2 maminetsi 70."
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rangarira kuti i maminetsi mangani kana minute hand ye clock ichitenderera kamwe.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Funga kuti 3:70 yaizova chii kana ukaiverenga pa clock.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora kuti ungashandura sei maminetsi 70 kuita maawa nemaminetsi here?
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti chii chinoitika kumaawa kana maminetsi asvika 60 here?
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana yasvika maminetsi 60, inova awa 1, saka unofanira kushandura maminetsi 70 kuita awa 1 maminetsi 10.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Awa 1 i maminetsi 60, saka unogona kunyora kusvika maminetsi 59 chete. Maminetsi 70 i awa 1 maminetsi 10.
x-m-e2-08.s.s2.because.model.2: Pa clock, maminetsi 60 i kutenderera kumwe kwakazara, saka hapana mark yemaminetsi 70. Maminetsi 70 anonyorwa zvakare seawa 1 maminetsi 10.

x-m-e2-09.title: Zvinogona nezvisingagone kutiudzwa netebhura
x-m-e2-09.goal: Siyanisa zvirevo zvaunogona kuziva zvakananga kubva patebhura nezvisingagoneke, uye gadzira mubvunzo wekuwana zvakawanda zvaunoda kuziva.
x-m-e2-09.material:
Vadzidzi veGrade 2 vakasarudza chibereko chimwe chete chavanoda kudya mushure me lunch. Pazasi pane tebhura yemhedzisiro ye survey.
Chibereko: apuro, sitirobheri, girepisi, tangerine
Huwandu hwevadzidzi vakachisarudza: 7, 9, 5, 4
(Kana ukachiratidza mu graph, bhawa re sitirobheri ndiro refu zvikuru uye bhawa re tangerine ndiro pfupi zvikuru.)
x-m-e2-09.thinking.0: Kutonga kana chirevo chakarurama uchishandisa data iri mutebhura chete
x-m-e2-09.thinking.2: Kuita mubvunzo we survey kuti uwane zvakawanda
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.prompt: Tarisa tebhura uye usarudze zvose zvaunogona kuti zvakarurama.
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa imwe neimwe kana chirevo chega chega chinogona kusimbiswa nenhamba dziri mutebhura.
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ratidza zvirevo zvine ruzivo rusiri mutebhura (remangwana, zvisingafarirwe).
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.o.a: Kana tikaita survey mwedzi unotevera, sitirobheri ichasarudzwa nevadzidzi vazhinji zvakare
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.r.a: Kana wasarudza sarudzo iyi: unogona kunge wakava nechokwadi nezvemangwana kubva pa data yazvino. Tebhura inoratidza mhedzisiro ye survey iyi chete.
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.o.b: Vadzidzi vakawanda vakasarudza sitirobheri kupfuura chero chibereko chimwe
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.r.b: Kana wasarudza sarudzo iyi: wakaiverenga nekuenzanisa nhamba dziri mutebhura. Kana wakaisiya, enzanisa nhamba dzevadzidzi dzezvibereko zvina padivi pedivi.
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.r.c: Kana wasarudza sarudzo iyi: waona "vakasarudza" ne "havafarire" sezvakafanana. Funga kana unogona kuziva kubva patebhura kuti vadzidzi vapi havafarire chimwe chinhu.
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.o.d: Vadzidzi 11 vose vakasarudza apuro kana tangerine
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.r.d: Kana wasarudza sarudzo iyi: wakaiverenga nekuwedzera nhamba mbiri dziri mutebhura. Kana wakaisiya, wana nhamba ye apuro neye tangerine uye uzviise pamwe chete.
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.o.e: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vakasarudza tangerine i hafu yehuwandu hwakasarudza girepisi
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.r.e: Kana wasarudza sarudzo iyi: unogona kunge wakava nechokwadi kuti tangerine i "hafu" nekuti i shoma kupfuura girepisi. Enzanisa nhamba mbiri iwe pachako.
x-m-e2-09.s.s1.explain: Sitirobheri ine yakawanda ne 9, uye apuro 7 pamwe ne tangerine 4 zvinoita 11. Mhedzisiro dzemangwana, huwandu hwevadzidzi vasingafarire chimwe chinhu, nehafu yegirepisi (hafu ye 5 haisi 4) hazvigone kuzivikanwa kubva patebhura kana hazvina kururama.
x-m-e2-09.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza chinhu chimwe chaunoda kuziva chausingagone kuziva kubva patebhura iyi oga, uye unyore kuti ungabvunza sei shamwari dzako kuti uchiwane.
x-m-e2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga zvakare kuti tebhura ine rudzi rwuri rwuzivo.
x-m-e2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Shandura zvaunoda kuziva kuita mashoko aunogona kubvunza shamwari dzako.
x-m-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Chandinoda kuziva i chinhu chisiri mutebhura here?
x-m-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakachinyora semubvunzo shamwari dzako dzinogona kupindura here?
x-m-e2-09.s.s2.model.0: Ndinofarira kuziva zvikonzero zvavakasarudza. Ndinogona kubvunza shamwari dzakasarudza sitirobheri kuti nei dzakaisarudza.
x-m-e2-09.s.s2.model.1: Ndinoda kuziva kana kune shamwari dzisingafarire zvibereko. Ndinobvunza, "Chibereko chipi chausingadi kudya?"
